run_replace_oovs: run the preprocess script to replace out-of-vocabulary words with position-based unk tokens in source and target sequences
run_preprocess_cli: run the CLI tool with --source, --vocab, and --source-out args to preprocess text for pointer generator models
run_preprocess_with_target: run the preprocess script with --target and --target-out to also replace matching OOV tokens in target sequences
review_replace_oovs: review the replace_oovs function that maps OOV words to their source sequence positions using angle bracket tokens
refactor_replace_oovs: refactor the replace_oovs function to use a set for vocabulary lookups instead of a list for better performance
